trust_sql: CREATE INDEX approval_requests_reusable_subject ON approval_requests(repository_id, subject_digest, status, expires_unix_ms, created_unix_ms, id);
sql: UPDATE run_approval_authorizations AS authorization SET subject_digest = metadata.approval_subject_digest FROM runs JOIN capsule_api_metadata AS metadata ON metadata.capsule_id = runs.capsule_id WHERE runs.id = authorization.run_id AND authorization.kind = 'privileged-execution' AND authorization.one_shot = FALSE AND metadata.approval_subject_digest <> authorization.subject_digest;
